title: Is spectral predictability enough? Testing {\Omega}-matching for synthetic pretraining under distribution shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.30802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic pretraining under distribution shift requires deciding what synthetic data to use. A natural criterion is to match the spectral predictability $\Omega$ of the source to the target, but is $\Omega$ sufficient? We test this hypothesis, which we call predictability-aware pretraining, across three architectures (LSTM, PatchTST, TCN) and three seeds. Under ideal synthetic-to-synthetic conditions, $\Omega$-matched pretraining can outperform even an oracle baseline (+46.8% MSE reduction, LSTM), though the benefit is already architecture-dependent. On the real-world ETTm1 benchmark, however, this relationship does not hold: sine-plus-noise pretraining at matched $\Omega$ yields only a marginal mean improvement +2.3% averaged over all three architectures, up to +65.5% on individual channels), whereas $\Omega$ matched chaotic ODE trajectories systematically degrade performance -13.2%). translated_title: 谱可预测性就足够了吗？在分布偏移下测试Ω匹配的合成预训练方法
translated_abstract: 在分布偏移下进行合成预训练需要决定使用什么样的合成数据。一个自然的准则是使源数据的谱可预测性Ω与目标数据相匹配，但Ω是否足够？我们在三种架构（LSTM、PatchTST、TCN）和三个随机种子下测试了这一假设，我们称之为可预测性感知预训练。在理想的合成到合成条件下，Ω匹配的预训练甚至可以超越oracle基线（LSTM的MSE降低+46.8%），尽管这种收益已经呈现出架构依赖性。然而，在真实世界的ETTm1基准上，这种关系并不成立：在匹配Ω的条件下，正弦加噪声的预训练仅带来微小的平均改进（三种架构平均+2.3%，个别通道最高+65.5%），而Ω匹配的混沌ODE轨迹则系统性地降低性能（-13.2%）。这两种数据源在迁移方向上……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 论文通过多架构实验发现，仅匹配谱可预测性Ω不足以指导分布偏移下的合成预训练——尽管在理想合成条件下Ω匹配预训练可超越oracle基线，但在真实世界基准上，不同类型的Ω匹配合成数据（正弦加噪声与混沌ODE轨迹）会产生截然相反甚至负面的迁移效果。
